d: Scale is growing rapidly, and joining the Global Public Sector team is an opportunity to work on one of the most rapidly expanding teams at Scale. This team is responsible for generating, executing, and fostering Scale’s work outside of the United States. There are three core types of work involved:
Building custom AI applications for government
Providing high-quality training data for research institutions building LLMs from scratch

As the founding Engagement Manager for Kuwait, you will be responsible for establishing deep customer and prospect relationships, proactively identifying opportunities where Scale can build custom AI applications to improve lives for citizens and residents, overseeing the execution to ensure timelines are met and/or communicated effectively, interfacing with premier research institutions to discuss how Scale can best support them, and partnering with organisations who are looking to train and educate people on how to use AI, AI safety, and more.
You and your team will work closely with the business development and go-to-market team, the product and engineering execution teams, and various customers and prospects to ensure success.

The ideal candidate has a nose for value and opportunity, is highly personable and can build relationships with all types of stakeholders, is an excellent communicator, is highly organised, and has a demonstrated track record of high-achievement. They are naturally empathetic and excel at building long-term relationships through diligent problem-solving and thoughtful, strategic discussions.

The blend of customer engagement, operations, and business development to drive our most important outcomes makes this a unique and exciting role at the heart of one of Scale's most exciting growth businesses.
r: Drive the process of identifying high-value use cases for custom LLMs that Scale can build within government entities
Partner with clients to understand their most pressing problems and brainstorm how Scale can best help
Manage the long-term health of clients by identifying and preempting areas of risk or concern
Be the main point-of-contact for clients if they have any questions, issues, or concerns and triage accordingly
Collaborate with the operational and engineering execution teams to track delivery and timelines
Review, track and improve operational performances and be obsessed with continuous improvement
Brainstorm with premier research institutions building Arabic LLMs how Scale can best support and/or ideas they should consider testing
Have proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking in Arabic
5+ years of total work experience, with experience in consulting or as a technical program management role in industry
Experience at a consulting firm or a leading tech company, ideally within Kuwait
A proven track record in B2B client facing roles and expanding client relationships
Ability to understand APIs and the ML training lifecycle and build great relationships with technical customers
Great cross-functional experience and collaborative ability
A track record of structured, analytics-driven problem solving
A history of diligence and organization across multiple work streams
An action-oriented mindset that balances creative problem solving with the scrappiness to ultimately deliver results
Analytical, planning, and process improvement capability

d: Join FxPro: a leading international fintech company. Be a part of our expanding international team, with offices in Limassol, London, Nassau, Dubai, and Yerevan. FxPro boasts a diverse workforce of over 600 employees representing 50 nationalities, making it an exciting and dynamic workplace. At FxPro, we see each team member as an integral part of our success story.

We are looking for a Payment Partnerships Manager with experience in payments within the CFD, forex, online trading or a similar high-risk industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing competitor payment offerings, identifying opportunities to improve our payment capabilities, and building strong relationships with payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers, banks and local payment providers across key markets.

The role combines competitor research, payment analysis, provider sourcing, relationship management and the testing and implementation of new payment solutions. The ideal candidate will be proactive, commercially minded and well-connected within the payments industry.
q: At least 3 years of experience in payments, PSP partnerships, payment operations or business development
Established background CFD, forex, banking, iGaming, crypto or a similar high-risk industry
An existing network of PSPs, acquirers, banks and alternative payment providers is highly desirable
Good understanding of card acquiring, local payment methods, e-wallets, bank transfers and payment processing
Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to assess competitor offerings and identify market opportunities
Experience in provider sourcing, relationship management and commercial negotiations
Strong organisational skills and the ability to maintain accurate databases and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
Excellent written and verbal English; additional languages are an advantage
Technical interview with Chief Of Operations
r: Research and monitor competitors across the CFD, forex, online trading and other relevant high-risk sectors to get full understanding of payment methods, providers, market coverage and overall payment offering
Review and test competitor and market payment solutions where possible, identifying strengths, weaknesses, gaps
Build and maintain a structured database comparing our payment offering with competitors, including payment methods, geographic coverage, providers, user experience and other relevant metrics
Identify and research potential PSPs, acquirers, banks and local alternative payment providers across target markets
Initiate contact, establish relationships and manage communications with prospective providers, from initial outreach through commercial negotiations and onboarding
Attend relevant payments, fintech, forex and online trading events to meet new providers, expand the company's network and identify potential partnership opportunities
Request and compare proposals, processing fees, transaction limits, reserves, settlement terms and other commercial conditions
Evaluate providers based on market coverage, payment methods, commercial viability, technical capabilities, operational reliability and regulatory requirements
Coordinate due diligence, payment testing and onboarding with internal teams and external providers, supporting the launch of new payment solutions
x: 21 days off and 10 sick leaves annually
Enjoyable break during Public Cyprus Holidays
Seasoned senior-level team with ample opportunities for professional growth in an international setting

d: Exciting Opportunity: Part-Time School Nurse (2 Days per Week, Sunday and Monday) Basic Working Hours: 7.00 am to 2.15 pm, with flexible ECA cover to 3.30 pm on Sundays when ECAs are running.

Doha English Speaking School (DESS) is the leading not-for-profit British curriculum school in Qatar, celebrated for its excellence in teaching and learning. In March 2023, we were rated Outstanding in all areas by PENTA International. We are proud members of IAPS, COBIS, and BSME.

As a dynamic preparatory school with a clear vision, DESS places learning at the heart of everything we do. Our students, representing over 45 nationalities (62% of whom are British), thrive in a culture that values success, enjoyment, and inclusivity. Led by a passionate and talented team, we are committed to high academic standards within a joyful and supportive working environment.
We are currently seeking an experienced and qualified School Nurse to join our team on a part-time basis (two days per week).

Following our recent Outstanding rating across all seven areas in the BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection, this is an exciting time to join our high-performing school. As a School Nurse, you will become part of a fast-paced and dynamic environment with the opportunity to contribute meaningfully across the entire school community. You will also benefit from a highly supportive, collaborative structure that promotes continuous professional growth.
q: Must be a licensed nurse in Qatar
Prior experience working with children or within a school setting is highly desirable
DESS is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. The successful candidate will be required to:
Provide an ICPC (International Child Protection Certificate) or a local/national equivalent
Submit police clearance from all countries of residence over the past 10 years, including Qatar.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy once sufficient applications have been received, so early application is strongly encouraged.
